highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 brings the Skia m152 renderer and new cross-platform GPU capabilities.
highlights_body: This release adds Graphite bindings and asynchronous GPU pixel readback, expands Vulkan support, and resolves several native lifetime issues.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates subsequent servicing and upstream correctness fixes.
Carries forward upstream m151 stability and browser bug fixes for consumers upgrading from earlier release lines.
Provides managed bindings for the Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn Graphite backends.
SKImage and SKSurface now offer backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs.

bullets.lead: Pixel and region lifetime issues corrected
bullets.detail: Roots native sources during SKPixmap subset and With operations and while enumerating SKRegion spans, preventing use-after-free failures.

bullets.lead: Native allocations are released on failure and reset
bullets.detail: Disposes raster-image pixel buffers after failed creation and replaces the previous uniform buffer when SKRuntimeEffectUniforms is reset.
Reduces copies and temporary allocations when saving SKData, converting four-byte tags, reading encoded text, and looking up runtime-effect uniforms.
Restores the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and adds native-symbol package generation for Apple platforms.

bullets.lead: Nano Server gains FreeType font support
bullets.detail: The Nano Server native assets use FreeType to provide font rendering support.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-backed font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the Skia m152 update, Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, and lifetime fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 finalized the Vulkan package, native-symbol packaging, and additional runtime fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves shaping performance by avoiding a defensive feature-array copy and fixes the non-memory-backed stream lifetime used to create HarfBuzz blobs.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m152 renderer and Graphite GPU bindings.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also adds asynchronous GPU pixel readback, expands Vulkan support, and fixes native object lifetime issues.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 finalizes the m152 feature set.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: It restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package and includes further native packaging and runtime fixes.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 delivers the Skia m152 renderer and new GPU APIs.
v4.152.0.body: The stable release includes Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, platform support updates, and lifetime fixes.
